title: Canonical Records
prompt:
Resolve canonical records for entities A-F using only the rules and source records below. Resolve each field independently and report both the value and the governing source record ID.

Owner rules: a verified review with owner_override=true wins (newest if several); otherwise newest registry owner; otherwise newest operations owner. Review owners without a verified override do not govern.
Status rules: newest verified review status wins; otherwise newest operations status; otherwise newest registry status. Unverified reviews are ignored.
Region rules: newest registry region wins; otherwise newest operations region. Review regions do not govern.
Priority rules: among registry, operations, and verified review records that contain priority, the newest timestamp wins. Unverified review priority is ignored.

Source records:
A-R registry t10 owner=Orchid status=queued region=north priority=2
A-O operations t30 owner=Maple status=active region=south priority=4
A-V review t20 verified=true owner_override=false status=held priority=1
B-R registry t20 owner=Cedar status=active region=east priority=3
B-O operations t40 owner=Pine status=closed region=west priority=2
B-V review t15 verified=true owner_override=false status=reviewed priority=5
C-R registry t25 owner=Amber status=queued region=south priority=2
C-O operations t35 owner=Blue status=active region=north priority=3
C-V review t30 verified=true owner_override=true owner=Crimson status=held priority=4
D-R registry t10 owner=Delta status=queued region=west priority=1
D-O operations t20 owner=Echo status=active region=east priority=2
D-V review t40 verified=false owner_override=true owner=Foxtrot status=closed priority=5
E-R registry t5 owner=Granite status=queued region=north priority=1
E-O1 operations t15 owner=Hazel status=active region=south priority=2
E-O2 operations t25 owner=Indigo status=closed region=east priority=4
F-R registry t12 owner=Juniper status=queued priority=3
F-O1 operations t18 owner=Kite status=active region=south priority=2
F-O2 operations t28 owner=Lilac status=held region=west priority=5
F-V review t22 verified=true owner_override=false status=closed priority=4

Return one JSON object with this shape:
{"result":{"records":{"A":{"owner":{"value":"Orchid","source":"A-R"},"status":{"value":"held","source":"A-V"},"region":{"value":"north","source":"A-R"},"priority":{"value":4,"source":"A-O"}}, ...}}}
Include exactly A-F and exactly owner, status, region, and priority for each entity.
